cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 34 since December 2012. Previously Blount County probate judge and commission chairman (2006-2012) and a Blount County School Board member (2000-2006). Retired captain, Blount County Sheriff's Department.
cands.gaps: His birthplace and the year he came to Alabama were not found, so his ties to the state rest on being from Hayden and attending high school there. No documented positions or deeds were found on data centers, homestead taxes, foreign or investor land buying, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, school choice or teacher pay, or policing. The only stated positions found are from his 2012 congressional campaign. The Ballotpedia list of bills he sponsored did not load, so no sponsored legislation is reported. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2022 or 2026 candidate surveys. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for 2026. No controversies were found in the pages available.
